regions.merged_text: My Dear Niece: God bless you and all yours! Many thanks for your kind remembrance of a month ago. Only To-day did I come to it though duely received and noted I've been down most of the time since a week or so before Christmas - eczema or its twin psoriasis. Thanks be to God, however, I only missed four holy Masses - two on Christmas and two otherwise. Otherwise my health has been good: God be praised. I hope you are all continuing well. How nice that so many of you can have your dear Mother so near. - - - - - - - - I have enrolled you for your hearing especially in the Ser M.As'n as the card indicates. I think it would help if you made a proposition to the Poor Souls - including your relatives specially- that you will enroll them most specilly, say for a small % of the Dr. bill if your hearing improve with out treatment so as to surprise the doctors Then have as many as possible to offer holy communion often. Fr. Sol.
